gaps.quote: Relabeling the coefficients by $\phi$ therefore turns the cyclic convolution of length $T$ into the $d$-dimensional cyclic convolution on the box
gaps.note: The page asserts with "therefore" that relabeling by phi turns the length-T cyclic convolution into a d-dimensional box convolution, but it never writes out the summation or the coefficient identity. The reader knows only 1-D cyclic convolution, so the claim that the sum over u+v mod T regroups into the per-axis wraparound sum over the box cannot be checked from the page.
